NEW src/commands/auth.ts. Local `gwrk auth key` subcommands writing `0600` non-checkout secret files with `ADR-004` signals. Tests: src/adapters/auth/credential-crypto.test.ts

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/db/operations.test.ts — In the `preserves execution and Slack receipt data across both migration 018 files` test (lines 194-201), add `"020-production-auth.sql"` after `"019-outbox-metadata-uniqueness.sql"` in the `.toEqual([...])` array for `SELECT name FROM _migrations WHERE name >= '015' ORDER BY id`.
FIX: vitest.config.ts — Add `"tests/hosted-pilot/gate-completeness.test.mjs"` to the `test.exclude` array (lines 20-27) so Vitest does not collect the `node:test` script invoked directly by `node tests/hosted-pilot/gate-completeness.test.mjs` in `specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-08.sh`.

REVIEW FAIL (uat): US-004 local private-host key administration CLI (gwrk auth key list text output) — Expected: `gwrk auth key list` in default text mode displays full untruncated public credential IDs (29-char default `cred_<24-hex>` IDs and up to 64-char public IDs) so operators can pass listed IDs directly to `gwrk auth key revoke <id>` and `gwrk auth key rotate <id>`. Actual: `src/commands/auth.ts:521` slices `cred.credentialId.slice(0, 28)`, truncating the final character of every default-generated credential ID (e.g., `cred_215d7127a5cfd3c4c8ed2e46` renders as `cred_215d7127a5cfd3c4c8ed2e4`), so passing the listed ID to `revoke` or `rotate` fails with exit 1 (`not found`). Behavioral regression patch: `.runs/review-regressions-phase-02-uat-list-id.patch`. See spec.md > US-004, FR-006. Fix: Restore `.runs/review-regressions-phase-02-uat-list-id.patch` first and observe RED on `pnpm vitest run src/commands/auth.test.ts`; remove `.slice(0, 28)` truncation on `cred.credentialId` in `src/commands/auth.ts` (size the Credential ID column dynamically to fit the longest ID without truncation); rebuild and pass `bash specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-02.sh`.
